Exness com Login: Step-by-step Access to Exness

Accessing your Exness account is a seamless process, but for those who are new or need a refresher, here’s a detailed step-by-step guide to ensure you get into your trading space without any hitches.

  1. Access the Official Website: Start by navigating to the official Exness website using your preferred web browser. Always ensure you’re visiting the genuine site to keep your credentials safe.
  2. Locate the Login Button: On the top right corner (or a prominent spot) of the homepage, you should see the ‘Login’ or ‘Sign In’ button. Click on it.
  3. Input Credentials: A login panel will appear, prompting you to enter your registered email address and password.
  4. Two-Factor Authentication (if enabled): If you’ve enabled additional security measures, you might be asked to input a verification code sent to your phone or email. Enter the code as instructed.
  5. Access Personal Area: Once authenticated, you’ll be directed to your personal area where you can view account details, trading history, and manage your trading settings.
  6. Trouble Logging In? If you face any issues, look for a ‘Forgot Password’ or ‘Help’ link. Following the prompts can assist you in recovering or resetting your password.
  7. Log Out: For security reasons, always remember to log out once you’re done with your trading activities, especially if you’re using a public or shared device.

Following these steps will ensure that you have a hassle-free experience while accessing your Exness account.

Tabs in Exness Personal Area

Dashboard

The Dashboard is the initial screen you see once you log in. It provides a brief overview of your account situation, from your available balance and open positions to market news. You can also view a list of quick actions, such as depositing or opening an account.

Deposit

The Deposit tab allows you to deposit money into your account. It provides multiple means of making deposits, such as bank transfers, credit/debit cards, and e-wallets. The procedure is simple and quick; most of the methods offer instant deposits.

Withdrawals

This Withdrawals tab allows you to withdraw from your account with Exness. Similar to deposits, withdrawals are processed in the shortest time possible, with the option to use preferred modes of payment.

My Accounts

In the My Accounts tab, you will be able to manage all of your Exness trading accounts. You can open new accounts, adjust the leverage, and view active and past accounts status in this area.

Transaction History

The Transaction History tab shows deposits, withdrawals, transfers, refunds (including bank card refunds), rewards and rebates.

Settings

Account preferences that can be set up on the Settings tab include password change, two-factor authentication (2FA), and updates to personal information.
